name: Thang den
summary: The loop page likens thắng dền to Hà Nội floating cake or Lạng Sơn cong cake: sticky-rice flour and crushed mung beans inside, spheres boiled in water, eaten with coconut milk and a ginger drink. Vietnam Tourism calls them stuffed sticky rice balls. Dân Việt says round balls, sweet, hot, and slightly fatty, like chè trôi nước, and not the same dish as thắng cố. Both descriptions stay.
origin: The plateau on the loop page and on Vietnam Tourism. Đồng Văn on Dân Việt.
taste: Dân Việt: sweet, hot, and slightly fatty.
howToEat: The loop page says coconut milk and a ginger drink. Dân Việt does not name that sauce.
No clock is given, and Dân Việt does not pin a season.
where: On the plateau, and in Đồng Văn on Dân Việt.
seoTitle: Thang den in Ha Giang — sticky rice balls
seoDescription: Thắng dền stays as mung-bean spheres with coconut milk and ginger, and as sweet, hot, slightly fatty balls like chè trôi nước. It is not thắng cố.
